title: Creamy Sauerkraut Ravioli Bake
description: A comforting Italian-inspired casserole featuring ravioli, sauerkraut, and a rich creamy sauce.
instructions: Cook ravioli according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add sauerkraut and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly caramelized.
Stir in unique cheese blend and italian seasoning.
Combine cooked ravioli and sauerkraut mixture in a baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.
